### #Property

Apartament Molo ADDRESS: Chmielewskiego 7/5, Sopot

BOOKING.COM: booking.com/Share-hed5ci

APARTMENT One bedroom apartment with balcony (max 6 guests), unit 5. Bedroom: double bed and single bed. Living room: sofa bed and single bed.

CHECK-IN: 3 PM (15:00) CHECK-OUT: 11 AM

BUILDING ACCESS CODE: 5key5555 APARTMENT ACCESS: key in the lockbox

WIFI Network: UPC1615937 Password: HPDBLXFH

PARKING Public street parking.

BREAKFAST Not available.

BATHROOM Shower. Washing machine, hair dryer, toiletries.

KITCHEN Yes. Refrigerator with freezer, induction cooktop, microwave, coffee/tea facilities, basic kitchenware and utensils.

TV : Smart TV with cable channels.

### #Check-in Process

This property offers self check-in only. Reception check-in is not available.

Check-in instructions are automatically sent on the day of arrival via the SmartHotel application by email or WhatsApp. The message contains all information required for arrival, including the property address, building entrance code, safe box code, and apartment access instructions.

### Self Check-in

1.  Use the building entrance code provided in your check-in instructions to enter the property.
    
2.  Proceed to your apartment.
    
3.  Locate the key safe box assigned to your apartment.
    
4.  Enter the safe box code provided in your check-in instructions and collect the apartment keys.
    
5.  Use the keys to access the apartment.
    
6.  Please return the keys to the safe box upon departure, unless instructed otherwise.
    

If you cannot locate your check-in instructions, please check your email inbox, WhatsApp messages, and the messages section of your [Booking.com](http://Booking.com) account if your reservation was made through [Booking.com](http://Booking.com).

### ##AI Assistant Instructions

If the guest is still unable to locate the check-in information or complete the check-in process after reccomended steps, transfer the call to a receptionist for further assistance.

### #Early Check-in

Standard check-in begins at 3 PM (15:00) . We will do our best to prepare the apartment earlier whenever possible; however, early check-in cannot be guaranteed in advanced.

More accurate information regarding the possibility of early check-in can be provided on the day of arrival, once the housekeeping schedule and apartment status have been confirmed.

If the apartment is not yet ready upon arrival, guests may leave their luggage with us at the reception desk of Molo Residence hotel ( Pułaskiego 6a ) and return later once the apartment has been prepared.

### #Late Check-out

Standard check-out time is 11 AM. Late check-out is subject to availability and cannot be guaranteed in advance.

More accurate information regarding the possibility of a late check-out can be provided on the morning of departure. Guests are kindly asked to contact the reception desk on the day of check-out to confirm availability.

### ##AI Assistant Instructions – Late Check-out Requests

The AI assistant may approve a late check-out of up to 30 minutes beyond the standard check-out time without prior approval from the reception staff.

In such cases, the AI assistant must inform the reception team about the approved extension.

If a guest requests a late check-out exceeding 30 minutes, the AI assistant must not approve the request independently. The request must be forwarded to the reception staff for approval.

The AI assistant should clearly inform the guest that availability depends on occupancy levels, housekeeping schedules, and operational requirements.

### #Luggage Storage

Guests are welcome to store their luggage free of charge at the reception desk of Molo Residence, located at Pułaskiego 6A. Luggage storage is available during reception opening hours, from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

### #Policy

KIDS POLICY Children welcome. Extra beds not available. Cot available on request, free of charge.

PETS Small dogs up to 5 kg allowed, 60 PLN per night extra.

knowledge_bases.content:
ABOUT MOLO RESIDENCE We are a portfolio of 8 properties in Sopot, on the Baltic coast of Poland. Brands: Molo Residence (hotel + apartments), Riviera (apartments + rooms), Boho (rooms + apartment), plus two standalone units.

LOCATIONS

-   Pułaskiego 6a — Hotel Molo Residence (hotel rooms)
    
-   Pułaskiego 10b — Molo Residence Apartments AND Riviera Residence Apartments (same building)
    
-   Chopina 40/8 — Riviera Rooms (rooms with shared bathrooms)
    
-   Pułaskiego 6/2 — Boho Rooms (rooms with shared bathrooms)
    
-   Pułaskiego 6/3a — Boho Apartment (one apartment, same building as Boho Rooms)
    
-   Pułaskiego 17/4 — Apartament Molo Superior
    
-   Chmielewskiego 7/5 — Apartament Molo
    

ROOM TYPES AVAILABLE ACROSS THE PORTFOLIO

-   Hotel rooms: Classic (max 2), Superior (max 3). Hotel Molo Residence only.
    
-   Studio apartments (max 2–4)
    
-   One bedroom apartments (max 4–6), some with balcony
    
-   Two bedroom apartments (max 6–9), some with balcony
    
-   Four bedroom apartments (max 11)
    
-   Rooms with shared bathrooms: Double (max 2), Triple (max 3), Quadruple (max 4). Some with balcony.
    

LANGUAGES Staff speak English and Polish.

BOOKING Most properties are listed on Booking.com (each property has its own listing). Direct bookings also via the websites moloresidence.pl, rivierasopot.pl, bohorooms.pl.

ABOUT SOPOT Sopot is famous for its long wooden pier ("molo" in Polish), beach, and the Forest Opera amphitheater. Most properties are walking distance to the beach and the main pedestrian street (Bohaterów Monte Cassino).
